# hoffman-docs
Boilerplate, examples, and helpful documentation for UCLA's Hoffman2 Cluster (https://www.hoffman2.idre.ucla.edu/)

# How to use this resource
This repository contains templates and examples for ways to use the Hoffman cluster for CPU and GPU compute, as well as for large-scale data transfer, backup to UCLA Box, and other common use cases.
